configurator.title: Comparison Slots
configurator.description: Each slot is a model + settings combination. Add the same model multiple times with different settings to compare behavior.
configurator.emptyDescription: Add a slot to pick a model and settings, or use a quick-start preset above to get going.

presets.tempSweepDesc: Creates 3 slots of the same model at temperatures 0.2 (focused), 0.7 (balanced), and 1.2 (creative). See how temperature changes the output for the exact same prompt.
presets.deterministicPairDesc: Creates 2 slots of the same model with the same seed but different temperatures (0.3 and 1.0). The shared seed means any difference in the output is purely from temperature, not randomness.
presets.languageCompareTooltip: Compare how different languages affect token cost and model behavior

prompt.placeholder: Enter prompt to compare across slots...

diff.needTwoResults: Need at least 2 completed results to show a diff.
